gen-fs-bevellier-gf-saira: Bevellier is flat and stencil-cut, with wirelike strokes and tight sidebearings. Saira, a sans with rounded letters that stretch tall and a see-through gap in every s, gives those strokes room to breathe.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-sintony: Each Bevellier stroke holds one thickness, like a drawn cable. Sintony's chunky, tall midzone and smooth, unclogged curves give the sans-serif body real heft against that cable-thin display line.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-sulphur-point: Flat stencil cuts, tightly packed: that is Bevellier up top, graceful and sharp. Sulphur Point's bulky lowercase, open-gapped a and s, and marker-like line give the display letters a sturdy partner.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-ubuntu-sans: Sleek, stencil-flat and tightly spaced, Bevellier brings a graceful display look with a wide-looking lowercase. Ubuntu Sans counters with lowercase eyes as big as washers and strokes like bent copper pipe.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga lays down flat, single-weight lines with generous tracking. Beside it, Comico brings poured-lead lowercase and wide letterspacing, so the heading gets to do all the loud talking.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-mega: Whimsical but commanding, Comico stamps down heavy lowercase like poured lead, spread wide by loose letterspacing. Lexend Mega reads smoothly across many lines, drawn with a single nib throughout.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-tera: Comico stacks its lowercase like poured lead type, spread wide by loose letterspacing. Lexend Tera, a sans with plotter-pen lines and widely spaced, open-faced rounds, lets that mass stand out alone.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-zetta: Comico is whimsical and commanding, cast like poured lead type. It earns its keep when big and short, while Lexend Zetta carries the rest in cut-ribbon strokes and tall-bodied small letters.
gen-fs-expose-gf-amiko: Tight and striking, Expose packs its capitals and lowercase close in height, with a compressed, hurried cadence. Amiko, a sans-serif, loosens things with tall, crayon-thick lowercase and outward-pointing terminals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-telugu: Compressed and striking, Expose runs caps and lowercase nearly level, barely pausing. Anek Telugu, a sans with wide, tall bowls and unsealed rounds like an unlatched hook, gives the eye somewhere to rest.
